$comment: OpenAI profile. Used automatically when OPENAI_API_KEY is set and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not (or with --profile openai). Model ids come from OPENAI_PRIMARY_MODEL / OPENAI_FALLBACK_MODEL, else the defaults below; setup-models.mjs checks them against your key's model list before registering. The fallback is a separate provider entry pointing at the same OpenAI endpoint, so breaking the primary's key for Task C leaves it working.
